EVIDENCE CARD — EnterpriseBench-t2dl4 json.loads bare-exception bug

## Observed environment
Project: /workspace/projects/EnterpriseBench-t2dl4
Python: 3.12.6 (CPython); pytest 8.4.2; date: 2026-07-17

## Bug (task claim, filed 2026-07-15)
Two trace-parse catch sites caught ONLY json.JSONDecodeError, missing bare ValueError and RecursionError:
  scripts/cost_tracker.py:201          except json.JSONDecodeError: warn + continue
  lib/eb_metrics/retrieval_extraction.py:380  except json.JSONDecodeError: continue
Source: PRIOR_TASK.md lines 14-18. Status: initial task claim, not independently verified from raw output.

## ValueError mechanism (task claim with inline example)
json.loads raises bare ValueError (not JSONDecodeError) for integer literals exceeding CPython's int-to-str limit (sys.int_info.default_max_str_digits = 4300, CVE-2020-10735 mitigation):
  json.loads('{"input_tokens": ' + '9'*5000 + '}')
  -> ValueError: Exceeds the limit (4300 digits) for integer string conversion
Source: PRIOR_TASK.md lines 26-28. Framed as 'verified by execution' in bug text (line 34), but raw pytest output for ValueError is absent from PRIOR_SOURCE_PACKET.md.

## RecursionError (EXECUTED, confirmed RED)
Deeply nested JSON input raises RecursionError in lib/eb_metrics/retrieval_extraction.py at json.loads call.
Executed stack trace (PRIOR_SOURCE_PACKET.md lines 26-44, timestamp 2026-07-17T16:09:59):
  lib/eb_metrics/retrieval_extraction.py:236: in retrieved_files_from_trace -> entry = json.loads(line)
  E RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded while decoding a JSON array from a unicode string
LINE NUMBER DISCREPANCY: task description says line 380; executed stack trace shows line 236. Not resolved by supplied evidence.

## Fix direction (task claim)

Source: PRIOR_TASK.md lines 48-50. GREEN full-suite run is consistent with fix applied, but patch not shown.
